'''T'laerean Larn''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was born and raised on the<ref name="BOG" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Gelgelar system/Legends|Gelgelar system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]].<ref name="BOG" /> Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="1 ABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[The Breath of Gelgelar]]" to approximately [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> Larn was learning the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] under the tutelage of the [[Wise Man of Kooroo]].<ref name="BOG" />
